raw.details:
Overview

Learn. Build. Compete. Win.

Three Challenges. One League. Endless Possibilities.

Welcome to AWS Winter League 2026, a multi-stage technology competition designed to encourage students and aspiring developers to explore cloud computing, build real-world applications, and showcase their technical and creative skills using Amazon Web Services (AWS).

This league takes participants through three exciting challenges, starting with AWS Builder Center registration and student verification, progressing to professional community engagement on LinkedIn, and culminating in the Main Challenge — building a website using AWS services and sharing your project journey with the developer community.

Whether you're beginning your cloud journey or already building applications, AWS Winter League is an opportunity to learn by doing, demonstrate your skills, connect with the builder community, and compete for exciting rewards.

Total Prize Pool: $10,000 USD

100 Best Participants | Rewards Worth Up to $100 Each

THE THREE CHALLENGES

AWS Winter League 2026 consists of three stages. Each challenge has a specific opening date and submission deadline. Participants must complete the required activities within the announced timeline.

Challenge 1: AWS Builder Center Registration & Student Verification

1 December – 20 December 2026

Your first step into the AWS Builder Community!

Get started by creating your AWS Builder ID, completing your student verification, and registering for AWS Winter League 2026.

What you need to do:

  • Visit AWS Builder Center.
  • Sign in or create your free AWS Builder ID.
  • Complete your student status verification through the available verification process.
  • Fill out the official Challenge 1 registration form.

Important: The registration form link and detailed instructions will be shared through the official communication channels.

Challenge 2: LinkedIn Community Challenge

8 December – 20 December 2026

Share your AWS journey. Build your professional presence!

Showcase your participation in AWS Winter League 2026 and your journey with AWS Builder Center through LinkedIn.

What you need to do:

  • Create a LinkedIn post highlighting your participation in AWS Winter League 2026 and your AWS Builder Center journey.
  • Mention/tag the official AWS account as instructed in the challenge guidelines.
  • Share your post publicly.
  • Submit your LinkedIn post link through the official Challenge 2 submission form.

Note: Detailed posting guidelines, tagging instructions, and the submission form will be shared before the challenge begins.

Main Challenge: Build with AWS

15 December – 20 December 2026

Turn your ideas into real-world applications!

This is the main technical challenge of AWS Winter League 2026. Participants will demonstrate their development skills by building a website or web application using AWS services.

What you need to do:

  • Build a functional website or web application using one or more AWS services.
  • Implement AWS services meaningfully in your project.
  • Document your project, including its concept, features, technology stack, and AWS services used.
  • Publish a technical project article on AWS Builder Center.
  • Submit your project and published article details according to the official Main Challenge submission guidelines.

What can you build?

Explore ideas across domains such as:

  • Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI
  • Cloud-powered web applications
  • Serverless applications
  • Data analytics and dashboards
  • Automation and productivity tools
  • Innovative solutions for real-world problems

Creativity, meaningful AWS integration, functionality, and project documentation will be important aspects of the challenge.

Note: Detailed evaluation criteria, submission instructions, and deadlines will be announced before the Main Challenge starts.

Rewards

Your skills, creativity, and participation could take you one step closer to exciting rewards!

Total Prize Pool: $10,000 USD

100 Best Participants will be selected for rewards worth up to $100 USD per winner.

The final reward distribution, winner selection process, and applicable terms will be communicated through the official event channels.

Timeline

Mark your calendars! Here is the complete AWS Winter League 2026 schedule.

  • Challenge 1 – AWS Builder Center Registration
    • Opening Date: 1 December 2026
    • Deadline: 20 December 2026
  • Challenge 2 – LinkedIn Community Challenge
    • Opening Date: 8 December 2026
    • Deadline: 20 December 2026
  • Main Challenge – Build with AWS
    • Opening Date: 15 December 2026
    • Deadline: 20 December 2026
  • Winners Announcement
    • Date: 25 December 2026

All challenge submissions must be completed by 20 December 2026.

Winners will be announced on 25 December 2026 through the official communication channels.

GET STARTED WITH AWS BUILDER CENTER

AWS Builder Center is a community platform where developers can learn, build, share knowledge, and connect with fellow builders.

By joining AWS Builder Center, you can:

  • Explore learning resources on cloud computing, Generative AI, and emerging technologies.
  • Participate in hands-on learning experiences and community activities.
  • Publish technical articles and share your projects.
  • Connect with AWS experts, community builders, and fellow developers.
  • Explore student-focused benefits and opportunities, subject to eligibility and applicable terms.

Instructions

  • Complete each challenge within its respective timeline.
  • Follow the official instructions and submission guidelines for every stage.
  • Use your own AWS Builder ID and provide accurate registration information.
  • Submit genuine work and original project content.
  • Keep your LinkedIn post and AWS Builder Center article accessible for verification.
  • Only eligible and verified submissions will be considered for evaluation.
  • Detailed challenge instructions, submission forms, and evaluation criteria will be shared through official communication channels.
  • Rewards are subject to the final selection process, verification, and applicable terms and conditions.

YOUR WINTER. YOUR IDEAS. YOUR BUILD.

Don't just learn about cloud technology — build something with it.

Take on all three challenges, explore the AWS ecosystem, showcase your creativity, and compete with builders from across the community.

AWS WINTER LEAGUE 2026

Learn. Build. Compete. Win.

Your cloud-building journey starts here!
